title: OFE Summer Reading List
content:
As things wind down over the summer, it’s a good moment to catch up on reading that gets pushed aside during busier months. OpenForum Europe’s summer reading list brings together a mix of our own work, research papers, and policy pieces.

You’ll find pieces on public sector adoption of open source, EU policy developments such as the Tech Sovereignty Package, and case studies from countries and organisations putting open technologies into practice. Some are short reads, others go deeper into the data and the arguments behind them. All are worth your time.

Here’s what’s on our list.

Open Source Software in Europe’s Telecoms Industry: Capabilities, Ecosystems, and Policies for More Sovereign and Competitive Future.

The report examines the role open source plays in Europe’s telecoms industry today, the structural and regulatory barriers that constrain its potential, and the policy choices that could make it a lever for a more open, horizontal, and sovereign European telecoms ecosystem. Read more 

Funding Europe’s Open Digital Infrastructure: The Economic, Legal, and Political Feasibility of an EU Sovereign Tech Fund (EU-STF).
